releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.39 — built for instant. The realtime socket could previously give up for good (an empty token ended its retry loop) or stall for up to 30 seconds between attempts, and nothing caught up on what was broadcast while it was down — which is why changes showed up a few seconds late. It now reconnects immediately, renews its own login before handshaking, wakes the moment the app comes to the foreground, and re-reads the chat list and open conversations after any gap. Friend requests, accepted invites, new groups, group renames and new statuses are applied straight from the event instead of reloading everything. Typing indicators expire instead of sticking, an open chat keeps itself fresh whenever realtime is down, and a small "Connecting…" pill shows the real state.
